question: According to the Koppen type of climate, the code Cs of group C represents:
solution:
The correct answer is __**dry hot summer**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Koppen type of climate, **the code Cs of group C represents dry hot summer**.
 
• Precipitation in the **driest month of summer is less than 1/3 the amount in the wettest winter month **in the regions coming under **Cs **category.
 
• The group C classification of the Koppen climate **includes temperate climates**.
 
• Regions under the **C category **experience **warm dry summers and wet, cool winters**.
 
• The other 2 subcategories of group C of the Koppen Climate are 
 
 
• **Cw -Mild temperate dry winter **
 
• **Cf -Mild temperate humid ​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Koppen climate **classification system was given by **Wladimir Koppen, a German botanist, and climatologist at the end of the 19th century**.
 
• The **system divides the world into five climate zones **based on criteria, usually temperature, which allows for different vegetation growth.
 
• 
 
The zones are as follows:

 
 
• **Zone A: tropical or equatorial zone**
 
• **Zone B: arid or dry zone **
 
• **Zone C: warm/mild temperate zone **
 
• **Zone D: continental zone **
 
• **Zone E: polar zone **
